_doc: Register of override flags: every flag of this machine's own tools that sets aside a gate verdict,
a refusal, or the gate's own controls is listed here. Reader: hooks/feedback_notice.py, which
notices a shell call carrying one of these flags in a session whose ledger has no feedback row for
that tool. Why: 2026-10-04/05 lab-skill-sync was forced through 4 times with --no-writeback because
the tool itself was wrong, and nothing reached the feedback pool (feedback_notice then fired only on
EDITS to a subsystem, never on overriding its gate).
script = path under ~/.claude; a command matches when it names <parent>/<basename> of it (either
slash) and carries the flag as a whole token (`--flag`, `--flag=x`).
Integrity: `python hooks/feedback_notice.py --selftest` fails when a listed script is missing, the
flag no longer appears in its source, or feedback.target_of() cannot map it.
review-when: a tool under ~/.claude gains a flag that bypasses its own check (add a row), or one
listed here drops it (the selftest names it).
_share_template: SHARE TEMPLATE: the source environment's register lists its own tools' override flags; this copy keeps only the rows whose script ships under instruments/ (so the integrity selftest can resolve every row) and the one shipped reviewed-not-override row. Add a row for each gate-bypassing flag of YOUR tools.

overrides.sets_aside: a companion number absent from the original fails the values check
the gate's own calibration controls / the page's declared class

reviewed_not_overrides.tools/process-ledger/report.py --force: writes a new report skeleton beside the old one
reviewed_not_overrides.reviewed: 2026-10-05, grep of argparse --force/--no-*/--skip*/--allow*/--override/--ignore*/--accept*/--waive* under tools hooks interop skills
